%@ param passenger shape=T kind=vector domain=passenger :: Number of passengers on train t.
%@ param delay_coeff shape=T kind=vector domain=cost :: Coefficient (delay cost per minute) for train t ( = dcost·passenger_t ).
%@ param penalty_coeff shape=T kind=vector domain=cost :: Penalty coefficient for cancelling train t ( = pcost·passenger_t ).
%@ param inc_out shape=N,A kind=matrix domain=bool :: Incidence: 1 if arc a leaves node n, 0 otherwise.
%@ param inc_in shape=N,A kind=matrix domain=bool :: Incidence: 1 if arc a enters node n, 0 otherwise.
%@ param origin shape=T kind=vector domain=node :: Origin node of train t.
%@ param dest shape=T kind=vector domain=node :: Destination node of train t.
%@ var x shape=T,A domain=binary role=primary drole=- :: Arc‑usage variable: 1 if train t traverses arc a.
%@ var s shape=T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- :: Start time of train t at its origin.
%@ var u shape=T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- :: Arrival time of train t at its destination.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- :: Cancellation indicator: 1 if train t is not served.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total passenger delay plus cancellation penalties.
%@ con flow_origin kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Flow conservation at origin nodes.
%@ con flow_dest kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Flow conservation at destination nodes.
%@ con flow_intermediate kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Flow conservation at intermediate nodes.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arc capacity limits.
%@ con timing kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Relation between start, travel, and arrival times.
